title: chinese state oil giant cnooc sees potential us china energy cooperation 2026 08 27
text:
Aug 27 (Reuters) - Chinese state-owned oil and gas major CNOOC (600938.SS)

 sees potential for energy ​cooperation between China and the United States, its ‌CEO said on Thursday, adding that the company would consider investments alongside U.S. partners in the future.
